# Security policy

Do not commit access tokens, production credentials, raw biometric material, unencrypted private media, or unredacted message content. Reproduce security failures with synthetic fixtures. Pull-request jobs must be credential-free. Private cross-organization integration must use an approved short-lived GitHub App installation token in a gated workflow; do not add PAT fallbacks or persistent fleet tokens.
